我开心的一天(My Happy Day): 说话者用简单英语介绍自己的一天与喜好。
Tom often helps me with English.
My friend Tom is very kind.
I often play football after class.
We talk about English a lot.
We often go to the bookstore together.
In fact, off-peak tickets cost half price.
